engineering_objects: Build a physically causal, thermally coupled lithium-ion cell cycling model with electrochemical transport and ageing.
Ageing must evolve through physically connected SEI-film growth and lithium-plating mechanisms that reduce negative-electrode porosity and capacity state of health;
Across the declared range, keep voltage, current, temperature, state of charge, electrode potentials, porosity, film thickness, and all capacity-loss terms finite and physically consistent.
